verdict.rationale: Skyfire pay/kya-pay tokens are scoped, limited-use credentials: amount is committed at creation and acts as a hard ceiling, tokens have expiry windows (10s–24h) with a bounded grace period, and merchant/service restrictions apply via seller-service and identity requirements rather than a raw card number. This is documented in first-party docs and corroborated by a live API probe showing the token endpoints are real and key-gated. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) confirmation of real-world merchant-restriction enforcement and no hands-on end-user report of the full credential-issuance flow.
